verses.1: The words of Jehovah, spoken by Tsefanya, son of Kushi, son of Gdaleya, son of Amaria, son of Hizkia, in the days of Josiah, son of Amon, king of Judah.
verses.2: All was gathered from above the earth, “May the LORD be praised!”
verses.3: I gathered men and women together. I also gathered the birds of the sky, as well as the fish of the sea. I gathered those who were evil and rebellious. I recognized man from above the earth, says Jehovah.
verses.4: And I raised my hand over Judah and over all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. From this place, I recognized the rest of the men, along with the priests.
verses.5: And those who bow down to the heavenly beings, and those who praise Jehovah and their king.
verses.6: And those who reject God’s commands, and who do not seek out God or ask for His guidance.
verses.7: May the Lord’s altar be sanctified, for the day of the Lord is approaching. The Lord is preparing a sacrifice for His holiness.
verses.8: And it shall be on the day of Yahweh’s sacrifice. I will command the singers and the sons of the king, and all those who are skilled in singing.
verses.9: And I supervised all the merchants on that day, when their houses were filled with goods and treasures.
verses.10: And on that day, the voice of Jehovah shall be heard from the pens of the animals. It will cry out from among the sheep and cattle. A loud noise will be heard from the fields.
verses.11: The inhabitants of the city trembled, for it seemed that all the people of Canaan had been destroyed. All those who wore gold jewelry were also destroyed.
verses.12: And on that day, I will take Jerusalem by force. I will also deal with those who are stubborn and refuse to obey God’s commands. They say in their hearts, “The Lord will not do good to us.”
verses.13: And they will be a people who worship idols. In their towns, there will be places for worshiping idols. They will build houses, but they will not live in them. They will plant trees, but they will not drink their sap.
verses.14: The day of Jehovah’s greatness is near, quickly and urgently. The voice of Jehovah cries out there, where the king reigns.
verses.15: Today is a day of sorrow and suffering. It’s a day of darkness and gloom. It’s a day filled with clouds and fog.
verses.16: A day of destruction and chaos for the poor cities and those living on the high hills.
verses.17: And I created man, but they walked iniquity. For they sinned against God; their blood was like water, and their violence was like wind.
verses.18: Neither their money nor their gold will be able to save them on the day of Jehovah’s judgment. In His anger, all of the land will be consumed. For all those who live in the land will be destroyed.
